posts.title: Structured Concurrency
posts.description: I’m going to show you some examples of how Raven handles async, which might seem surprising. Then I’m (I hope) going to convince you that it’s a sensible and even elegant approach to some difficult problems in concurrency, despite being unusual. You can start a background task with the async keyword, which returns a Task object: t = async { sleep( 1 ), 2 + 2 }
